fullDescription: A futuristic visual audit and content moderation terminal featuring a high-end dark mode aesthetic. Utilizing glassmorphism, depth-focused layouts, and a vibrant purple-pink gradient accent system. This design is optimized for SaaS dashboards, fintech platforms, asset management systems, and media moderation tools. Key elements include 3D-transform interactive image previews, floating glass widgets, and editorial typography combining Cabinet Grotesk for high-impact headings and Satoshi for functional body text.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, high-contrast visual audit interface in dark mode. It uses a three-column layout (Queue, Preview, Data) with glassmorphism panels, interactive hover effects, and a floating statistical widget for real-time monitoring.

style.description: The style is 'Cyber-Minimalist' with a heavy emphasis on glassmorphism and light-bleed effects. Primary color is a deep black (#0e0e0e) contrasted with a vivid purple-to-pink gradient (linear-gradient(135deg, #6a48f2 0%, #d946ef 100%)). Typography pairings include 'Cabinet Grotesk' (italic, black weights) for branding and 'Satoshi' for data density. Shadows are glow-based rather than drop-shadow based, using rgba(106, 72, 242, 0.3).
style.prompt: Create a UI with a dark background (#0e0e0e). Use a glassmorphism effect for all containers: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(20px), and a subtle border of 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Implement an accent gradient of #6a48f2 to #d946ef for primary buttons and status indicators. For typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Bold, Italic) for section titles and 'Satoshi' (400-700 weight) for metadata. Animations should include a soft pulse-glow for background orbs (radial-gradient(circle, rgba(106, 72, 242, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%)) and a smooth cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) transition for interactive elements.

layout_and_structure.description: A full-height fixed viewport layout consisting of a horizontal header, a thin left sidebar for visual queues, a large central workspace for inspection, and a thick right sidebar for data entry and decision-making.

prompts.prompt: Height 80px. Glassmorphism finish. Left side: Brand logo with a rotated gradient box icon and 'Cabinet Grotesk' black italic text. Center: Search bar with integrated filters using border-r for logical separation. Right side: User profile with avatar and notification bell, separated by a vertical border line.

Width 96px to 128px. Vertical stack of 64x64px rounded-xl thumbnails. Active thumbnail has a 2px purple border (#6a48f2) and glow. Inactive thumbnails are grayscale and 40% opacity, becoming color on hover.

Flexible center area for primary content. Centered image preview with a 3D perspective tilt effect on mouse move. Overlays in the top-left corner of the image display 'AI Confidence' and 'Recommendation' using semi-transparent pill badges. Bottom toolbar provides 4-5 icon-based controls (zoom, rotate, etc.) with uppercase labels.

Width 380px. Scrollable vertical content. Sections include: 'Resource Metadata' (2-column grid cards), 'Audit Opinion' (large textarea with predefined tag buttons), 'Uploader Info' (profile card), and 'Audit History' (vertical timeline with bullet points). Action area is fixed to the bottom with high-contrast buttons: 'Reject' (red border), 'Hold' (glass style), and 'Approve' (full gradient background with shadow).

Fixed at bottom-left, 24px from edges. Glass container with p-2 padding. Includes a gradient icon box followed by three stats separated by 1px height-8 lines. Labels use text-white/40, uppercase, 9px font. Data values use Satoshi Black Italic, 14px font. Stat colors: default white, emerald-400 (Success), and orange-400 (Warning).

special_ui_components.description: An image container that tilts based on cursor position for a tactile feel.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a container with perspective: 1000px. On mousemove, calculate the relative X and Y positions (0 to 1) and apply transform: rotateY((x-0.5)*5deg) rotateX((y-0.5)*-5deg) scale(1.02). Transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Ensure a deep shadow of 0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.8) follows the container.

special_ui_components.description: High-priority decision buttons with distinct visual hierarchy.
special_ui_components.prompt: Bottom action bar using a grid layout. 'Approve' button must have background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a48f2 0%, #d946ef 100%), border-radius: 16px, height: 56px, and a soft glow shadow of rgba(106,72,242,0.4). 'Reject' button must have border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2) and text-red-500.

structured.special_notes: Must-dos: Ensure all glass cards have an 8% opacity white border to prevent them from blending into the background. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' specifically for the terminal's professional but edgy 'italic' aesthetic. Must-nots: Do not use standard shadow offsets; use glow-based drop shadows for primary buttons (#6a48f2 opacity). Do not use solid backgrounds for any secondary elements; maintain transparency and blur throughout.
